scenes.title: Prepare a useful comparison
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show fictional units, station assignments and current statuses.
scenes.practice: Compare Engine 51, Truck 81 and Reserve Engine 51: record their visible status, station and crew context.

scenes.title: Give the call a location
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Fill call basics and place a real training pin.
scenes.practice: Set one clear incident pin and confirm the written coordinates describe the same point.

scenes.title: Read the unit lists
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Frame All Units/station tabs with nearest badges and ETA values.
scenes.practice: Explain why the first ranked available unit is or is not appropriate for your exercise.

scenes.title: Separate response time from distance
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show actual saved station turnout120/mobile0 and the nearest rows with incl.120s annotation, estimated2minute response.
scenes.practice: Compare the saved 120-second station allowance with the literal incl. 120 s turnout annotation, and explain why 0.0 km does not mean an instant response.

scenes.title: Read crew and role mix
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show actual empty seat/No crew assigned, select Herrmann for Engine51 Officer/TeamLead, saved assignment then actual refreshed crew/role mix. Clarify FullyStaffed refers to one configuredseat.
scenes.practice: Compare the one saved training seat with the resulting crew and role mix; distinguish configured staffing from your real operational minimum.

scenes.title: Inspect the position source
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Open resource position modal and show call/resource together.
scenes.practice: Describe the visible position source and freshness for one suggested unit.

scenes.title: Compare personnel separately
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show actual stale simulated Herrmann fix, refresh only guarded fictional fixtures, then actual own-position ETA/status/staffing; no claimed device GPS.
scenes.practice: Compare a person and a unit without treating their availability or positions as interchangeable.

scenes.title: Understand areas and scope
required_labels: The incident is not inside any group boundary

scenes.ordered_control_actions: Show actual GroupBoundary editor with empty station area, NewCall note notinsideanyboundary, and actual group dispatch scope/departmentwide roles. No boundary or permission changes.
scenes.practice: Identify whether the current operator has department-wide comparison scope, and distinguish a missing estimate from an unavailable unit.

scenes.title: Move the pin and compare again
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Capture before/after location change and corresponding ranked rows.
scenes.practice: Record how one named resource changes between two incident locations.

scenes.title: Make and verify the dispatch decision
scenes.ordered_control_actions: Select resource and confirm synchronized picks; save only authorized isolated test.
scenes.practice: Make one justified selection and compare the saved call list with your intended recipients.

declared_limits: No audio, speech timing, voice identity, rendering, extracted frames or browser playback is approved here.
All positions/resources are fictional. No device GPS, routed drive time, native alert receipt or external provider success is established.
The one Officer/TeamLead seat is unrestricted (no required-role FK; Required unchecked). Fully Staffed means its single seat is filled, not a complete operational engine crew.
Herrmann uses his own simulated position; On Engine51 does not copy the vehicle origin into his position.
Boden is a department administrator; this lesson does not demonstrate a restricted member or change permissions.
Scope candidate rules and unit-picker visibility are separate. Group Boundary controls are inspected without drawing/saving a polygon.
The Routine/Rescue nearest call does not demonstrate a matching run card. The conditional run-card sentence is review guidance, not a claim that its panel selected these recipients.
Actual Dispatched records prove stored assignment only; no recipient device acknowledgement is claimed.
